steps: local validator runs the wallet program
extension loads and is pinned to the local deployment
wallet keys are created and the setup address is shown
one funding transfer creates the wallet and moves the rest behind the post-quantum key
receive shows the program-owned wallet address with a QR code
the review window shows the decoded recipient, amount and fee refill before signing
a send is interrupted by closing its window mid-upload
the resumed send completes with exactly 11 uploaded chunks and the exact amount
the fee refund keeps the fee key topped up
home lists the wallet’s SPL token balance
an SPL token send completes through the review window without freezing it; Activity shows sends and received transfers
Send offers recent recipients; a token send to a new holder opens their token account (after asking) and delivers
an unclear submission stops as uncertain, is checked by signature, and resumes to exactly one transfer
a send superseded by another at the same nonce is reported "Not sent" and its proof deposit is reclaimed
a fee key below its float is refilled from the wallet through a reviewed sealed send
lock clears access; a wrong passphrase is refused; the right one unlocks
backup downloads encrypted keys plus the wallet descriptor; the Home reminder clears
the passphrase changes only with the current one
with "ask for my passphrase" on, a send is approved only with the right passphrase
settings save through the UI and the wallet auto-locks after the idle period
forgot passphrase: remove the wallet, restore the backup, and the same wallet returns
